v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Proprio de Tempore

text.la: Glória tibi, Trínitas * æquális, una Déitas, et ante ómnia sǽcula, et nunc et in perpétuum.
text.en: Glory be to thee, O equal Trinity * one Deity, from before all ages, so now and for evermore.

text.la: Laus et perénnis glória * Deo Patri, et Fílio, Sancto simul Paráclito, in sæculórum sǽcula.
text.en: Praise and endless glory be * to God the Father, the Son, and the Holy Paraclete, for ever and ever.

text.la: Glória laudis * résonet in ore ómnium, Patri, genitǽque Proli, Spirítui Sancto páriter resúltet laude perénni.
text.en: Let the glory of praise * be heard from the mouth of all to the Father, and to the begotten Son; let it equally resound with perpetual praise to the Holy Spirit.

text.la: Laus Deo Patri, * parilíque Proli, et tibi, Sancte, stúdio perénni, Spíritus, nostro résonet ab ore, omne per ævum.
text.en: Praise be to God the Father, * and to his co-equal Son, and to thee, O Holy Ghost: with perpetual delight may it resound from our lips for ever.

text.la: Ex quo ómnia, * per quem ómnia, in quo ómnia: ipsi glória in sǽcula.
text.en: From whom are all things, * through whom are all things, and in whom are all things: to him be glory for evermore.

text.la: O Altitúdo divitiárum sapiéntiæ, et sciéntiæ Dei, quam incomprehensibília sunt iudícia eius, et investigábiles viæ eius!
text.en: O the depth of the riches of the wisdom and of the knowledge of God! How incomprehensible are his judgments, and how unsearchable his ways!

v.la: Benedicámus Patrem et Fílium cum Sancto Spíritu.
v.en: Bless we the Father, and the Son, and the Holy Ghost.

r.la: Laudémus et superexaltémus eum in sǽcula.
r.en: Let us praise Him and exalt Him above all for ever.

text.la: Grátias * tibi Deus, grátias tibi, vera et una Trínitas, una et summa Déitas, sancta et una Unítas.
text.en: Thanks be * to thee, O God, thanks be unto thee, O True and One Trinity, O one almighty Deity, Holy and One Unity.

text.la: Omnípotens sempitérne Deus, qui dedísti fámulis tuis in confessióne veræ fídei, ætérnæ Trinitátis glóriam agnóscere, et in poténtia maiestátis adoráre Unitátem: quǽsumus; ut, eiúsdem fídei firmitáte, ab ómnibus semper muniámur advérsis.
text.en: Almighty and everlasting God, you have given thy servants in the confession of the true faith, to acknowledge the glory of the Eternal Trinity, and to adore the unity in the power of thy Majesty; grant, that by steadfastness in this faith we may ever be defended from all adversities.

office.title: Sabbato Quattuor Temporum Pentecostes Dies Octavæ
